title: Brady v. Maryland (1963)
key_points: Holding: Prosecutors must disclose evidence favorable to the defense that is material to guilt or punishment; Giglio v. United States (1972) extends this to impeachment evidence such as officer credibility issues.
officer_notes: Scenario: A witness tells you the suspect wasn't the shooter, but it doesn't make your report.
Takeaway: Document and forward everything, including information that helps the defense.
